# stage: reach above clamp
# arm planned, hand planned, dwell 0.2 s, timeout 6.0 s, horizon 1.0 s
# planned palm position, object frame (m): [0.02, -0.054, 0.206]
# planned hand targets (rad): finger0.base=1.20, finger0.spread=0.00, finger0.middle=0.15, finger0.distal=0.12, finger1.base=1.20, finger1.spread=0.00, finger1.middle=0.15, finger1.distal=0.12, finger2.base=1.20, finger2.spread=0.00, finger2.middle=0.15, finger2.distal=0.12, thumb.base=0.90, thumb.spread=1.40, thumb.middle=0.27, thumb.distal=0.18

# objective
def reach_objective(scene: Component) -> dict[str, Loss]:
    picked = cast(PickupScene, scene)
    palm = picked.assembly.robot.hand.origin.pose.pos
    relative = (~picked.assembly.obj.pose) @ palm
    target = jnp.asarray((0.020, -0.054, 0.206))
    return {"palm_target": Minimize(ejnp.sum((relative - target) ** 2))}

# effect
def reached(scene: Component) -> dict[str, Loss]:
    picked = cast(PickupScene, scene)
    palm = picked.assembly.robot.hand.origin.pose.pos
    relative = (~picked.assembly.obj.pose) @ palm
    target = jnp.asarray((0.020, -0.054, 0.206))
    distance = ejnp.sqrt(ejnp.sum((relative - target) ** 2))
    return {"palm_at_approach": KeepBelow(distance, 0.020)}

def contacted(scene: Component) -> dict[str, Loss]:

    return {"gentle_contact": KeepAbove(load, 0.05)}

# effect
def carried_clear(scene: Component) -> dict[str, Loss]:
    picked = cast(PickupScene, scene)
    bottom = picked.contact_observations["bottom_m"].get().x[0]
    load = picked.contact_observations["hand_normal_load_N"].get().x[0]
    mass = sum(float(value.to("kg").value) for _, _, value in picked.assembly.obj.parts_info)
    return {
        "clearance": KeepAbove(bottom, 0.035),
        "carried": KeepAbove(load, 0.95 * mass * 9.81),
    }

    mass = sum(float(value.to("kg").value) for _, _, value in picked.assembly.obj.parts_info)
    return {"still_in_hand": KeepAbove(load, 0.10 * mass * 9.81)}
